title: Weak split extensions of topological Abelian groups
summary: In the category of topological Abelian groups, we consider the usual notion of an extension $E=(B \to X \to A)$ of $B$ by $A$, together with the notion of a weakly split extension, i.e., an extension for which the projection $X \to A$ admits a continuous section $A \to X$. Given a weakly split extension $E$, the topological Abelian group $X$ is homeomorphic to $B \times A$, although in general it is not algebraically isomorphic to $B \times A$.
